ns2:section.sectionText: Spring 470 registration is for students whose UIN ends in an odd number. To petition a change in this spring registration, see staff in 154 MEB. ME students must obtain department approval from staff in 154 MEB to drop this course after the first day of class. You will receive a TIME CONFLICT ERROR when registering for this course. Please contact the MechSE Undergraduate Programs Office, 154 MEB, 217-333-0366, MechSE-Undergrad@uiuc.edu to receive the necessary override to register for the course.
